text:
The dish is a small white bowl, about 15 cm across. It holds a few dumplings, one green (spinach wrapper) and one white, topped with radish slices, chopped nuts and a little sauce.

I estimate 4–5 dumplings at roughly 25 g each, which comes to about 110 g. Adding sauce, nuts and radish brings the total to about 140 g.

Dumplings run about 2 kcal/g, so 110 g gives about 220 kcal. The nuts and sauce add roughly 50 kcal, for a total of about 270 kcal.
